changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), amount NUMERIC NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED' CHECK (status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSED')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), aggregate_id UUID NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NEW' CHECK (status IN ('NEW', 'SENT')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW() );
